name: Hammer
source:
A mysterious illness has spread throughout the world rapidly killing people everywhere and in desperation, you escaped and wandered aimlessly and ended up in some remote cabin somewhere in the middle of nowhere.

A Studio Mugenjohncel 2014 NaNoRenO Entry.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209115912/https://renai.us/game/hammer.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一种神秘的疾病在世界各地迅速蔓延，导致世界各地的人们死亡，在绝望中，你逃脱并漫无目的地徘徊，最终来到了某个偏僻的小屋。

Studio Mugenjohncel 2014 NaNoRenO参赛作品。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209115912/https://renai.us/game/hammer.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
